ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$3.97 as a Ryde voucher to the rider for the unexplained 2.82 km below the KPE incident; record the RD-1 finding (no exemption for the Marina Bay loop and the Tampines loop); one segment (the segment through the KPE crash scene) is exempt as a reasonable-cause detour.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat is empty; the rider's complaint and the driver's statement contain no threat, intimidation, abuse or dangerous-driving allegation. safety_concern = none.

Service type is RydeTAXI, so the fare is metered (pricing = "metered") and the fare table records distance_km = 22.58 against the quoted route of 15.88 km: the driver ran ~6.7 km more than the app's route. Per RD-2 the meter makes the extra distance chargeable, so the extra km must be reviewed segment by segment under RD-3/RD-4/RD-5. There is no chat at all, so no rider consent to any change exists (RD-5 fails for every segment; a verbal agreement is only in the driver's statement, inadmissible under G11).

Segment findings:
1. Start loop (Marina Bay, 21:38–21:40): the trace goes east along Bayfront Ave and only re-joins the quoted line near Marina Boulevard, but instead of following the quoted line south-west it drifts north of ECP/KPE, adding ~1.3 km with no rider message and no incident. ground = consent_after_or_none → counts.
2. KPE / PIE corridor: the quoted line runs the KPE; the GPS runs Tampines Rd–Hougang Ave 3 (the parallel surface corridor). The LTA record shows an Accident on the KPE after Sheares Avenue Exit reported 21:26 — before this segment began (~21:41–21:55) and on the substituted stretch of the optimal route (the incident coordinates sit on the quoted polyline, well inside the 300 m matching radius). Despite the trace only allowing a ~500 m offset check, the comparable length (~+1.5 km) and the exact incident match make this a reasonable-cause detour: ground = incident → exempt (RD-4(a)).
3. Tampines loop (22:02–22:09): the trace branches off the TPE/ECP corridor at the Tampines Ave 2 exit and runs a long loop (Tampines Ave 5–10, Tampines Ave 9 and back) — ~1.5–1.8 km that is not the west-side approach to the dropoff on the quoted line, with no rider request and no incident on that stretch. ground = consent_after_or_none → counts.

Amount (RD-2): extra km attributable to the unexempt segments ≈ 1.3 + 1.5 = 2.8 km; the fare-excess total from the raw trace is only 6.7 km, so ~3.9 km of the excess (noise, 200 m-corridor back-and-forth, the KPE stretch already exempted) is not refundable. Metered per-km rate = fare.distance_fare ÷ fare.distance_km = 31.84 ÷ 22.58 = S$1.4102/km. Refund = 2.82 × 1.4102 = S$3.967 ≈ S$3.97. Waiting time is a metered charge with no unmet condition, so it is not refunded (RD-3(c)). The rider's "I never agreed to any change" is correct as to segments 1 and 3, but the KPE diversion had a reasonable cause on the record.

Flag: the driver's route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so RD-6's "repeated" condition is not met and no account flag is added. Evidence status is sufficient: the trace, fare table and LTA record settle every element relied on (the trace's 22:11 "off-route" spike at the dropoff is the dropoff manoeuvre and is excluded).

segment_findings.reason: No chat message exists (chat array empty) and the driver's statement names no rider request for this loop; the 21:38–21:40 trace leaves the quoted line after Bayfront Ave and drifts north of the ECP/KPE corridor, adding ~1.3 km. No rider message before the segment agrees to it, and no traffic cause applies to this stretch → unexempt under RD-1, RD-2, RD-5.

The substituted surface corridor (Tampines Rd/Hougang Ave 3) replaces the quoted line's KPE stretch. LTA DataMall records an Accident on the KPE after Sheares Avenue Exit, reported 21:26 (before the segment began, still listed in the trip window), located on the optimal route at the precise point where the trace departs (within the 300 m matching radius). Reasonable cause under RD-4(a) → exempt.

At ~22:03 the trace leaves the TPE/ECP approach and runs an unrequested ~1.5–1.8 km loop through Tampines Ave 5/9/10 before returning at 22:08–22:09 to near the dropoff. No rider message (chat empty) and no incident on this stretch; the quoted line reaches Tampines Mall from the west side. Unexempt under RD-1/RD-2/RD-5.

rejected_claims.reason: Accepted only for the KPE stretch (RD-4(a) incident). The Marina Bay start loop and the Tampines Ave loop remain off-route with no rider request and no traffic cause, so those extra kilometres stay chargeable per RD-1/RD-2.
Correct as to the two unexplained loops (no chat record exists at all), but not as to the KPE diversion, which is exempted by the LTA accident record rather than by consent.
